nodes.label: ADR 001: Pull-only node transport
nodes.rationale: Superseded by ADR 008, retains typed-payload invariant to avoid exposing administrative APIs or generic remote execution

nodes.label: ADR 002: Declarative immutable generations

nodes.label: ADR 003: One writer per resource

nodes.label: ADR 005: Secrets travel as references
nodes.rationale: Carry SecretRef everywhere instead of raw credentials, encrypting values in secret_versions under AES-256-GCM master key to mitigate database/backup compromise
